name: rea
description: Understand how shipped software works through local, evidence-based analysis.

interface.longDescription: Trace how shipped software works. Inspect native, managed, JavaScript and Electron applications, compare versions, and connect findings to evidence. Use those findings to guide reconstruction. Powered by local REA analysis; native analysis engines are configured separately.
defaultPrompt: Use $reverse-engineer-anything to investigate this application and explain the evidence.
